title: chore(console): move the objectui pin 1d178e06ac5e → 6fb31dcc9954, past objectui#13370, so the console builds against the spec again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiVqegiix7AA9ngHhBhH78Zv)_

Fixes #25430
Part of #25438
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR moves the console pin from `1d178e06ac5e` (set by #25437) to `6fb31dcc9954`. That is objectui `main` at `6fb31dcc9954844b2631ecfa96e999c4f73c4881`, the merge of objectui#13370.

It does two things on the 18.1.0 path:

- **#25438: Console Pin Gate is red on `main`.**
  - #24947 made a bulk action's `confirmText` a `template` slot. objectui typed the envelope's `source` as required, so `@object-ui/plugin-view` fails its declaration build at `ObjectView.tsx:2615` against the current spec. It fails at every objectui commit before objectui#13370, including `1d178e06ac5e`.
  - objectui#13370 types `source` as optional, as the spec's `Expression` does. At this pin, `pnpm objectui:build` on this branch builds the console with no local patch.
  - This PR is marked `Part of` #25438, not `Fixes`. #25438 is closed when Console Pin Gate goes green on `main`.
- **#25430.** The new pin carries objectui#13361 (`f2f4b7dc3`, the #7611 remainder: Publish from Home no longer reports a `defineCapability` declaration as unresolved). The epic #15194 gate (c) re-test reads this change.

**Branch history.** The harness assigned the branch `claude/project-thread-nldmem`, and the card's `Claim:` names it. The branch first moved the pin from `5fef032b1ada`. After #25437 landed its own move to `1d178e06ac5e`, the branch merged `main`, took `main`'s side of the three conflicted files, and re-ran the bump from there. The net diff against `main` is the four files below.

## The diff

These are the same four files as in the earlier pin moves #25358 and #25262. The repo's own tooling wrote each one; none was edited by hand.

- `.objectui-sha` and `.changeset/console-6fb31dcc9954.md`: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=/home/claude/objectui OBJECTUI_NO_DEEPEN=1 bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh 6fb31dcc9954844b2631ecfa96e999c4f73c4881 --no-commit` exited 0. It printed "1d178e06ac5e..6fb31dcc9954 walks completely", "7 releasing changeset(s), 0 breaking" and "(on origin/main)".
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 pnpm objectui:build` exited 0 with "dist ready … from objectui@6fb31dcc9954" and "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it". Then `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` ran: 107 components, sha256 `d1fde278ffd6…`. `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical, so only its provenance record moves. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` passes.
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-6fb31dcc9954 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` recorded 214 region lines, blob `0131f27cf86d`, and 25 diagnostic codes. `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` passes. `pnpm check:console-sha` passes.

## The changeset

`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` derived it from the 7 changesets objectui added over `1d178e06ac5e..6fb31dcc9954`, across 7 non-merge commits. #25437's `console-1d178e06ac5e.md` already covers the earlier part of the range, so the two do not overlap. Under ruling A (#25105), a console refresh is `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Choosing the pin

`6fb31dcc9954` is objectui `origin/main`'s tip, and `1d178e06ac5e` is its ancestor. objectui CI on `6fb31dcc9954`:
- Push runs Lint 39968382243, Repo Gates 39968382372, Changeset Guard 39968382262, Changeset Release 39968382314 and Bundle Analysis 39968382271 succeeded.
- objectui#13370's own merge-queue run passed before it merged.

## Verification on the built console

I ran the F1 re-test for #15194 gate (c) on this branch's console at this pin, before the merge with `main`. F1 is absent; the reading is on #15194 (comment 6367439307). The injection stamp carries a real witness (`skew: true`).

## Out of scope

- No objectui source changed here.
- No product code, `.github/workflows/**`, `scripts/build-console.sh` or `content/docs/releases/` is in the diff.
- This PR is not a release act and does not touch the Version Packages PR #24876.
